title: Mixed Event — Wonderhorror?! A Test of Courage!

meta.Outline: Class representatives Emu and Mafuyu are assigned to run a voluntary weeding activity. But no one's signing up to pull weeds in the blazing summer heat! Emu thinks of a way to make it fun for the participants.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
That's all for homeroom.
Get home safe, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Hehe!
Now that homeroom's over, I can finally go to the class rep meeting♪)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I wonder what we're gonna talk about today. I really hope we start discussing school festival stuff soon!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm already getting super duper excited just thinking about it♪)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Emu!
You look more excited than usual today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I am!
That's because today...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You have another class rep meeting?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?!
How did you know?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, you haven't been able to stay still since this morning. Plus, you acted the same way before your last one, so I had a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But is being a class rep really that fun?
It seems like a really tough job since you have to plan events and lead your classmates.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?
Hmm... Yeah, it can be a little tough sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I'm having so much fun that none of that stuff bothers me at all!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me and the other class reps think really hard about how we can make everyone smile and laugh.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I get really happy whenever we manage to make that happen!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. You are really good at that, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, that means you gotta do your best during today's meeting! We'll be rooting for you, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I will!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Anyway, I gotta go!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Have fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Humhumhummm♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're supposed to meet in that classroom today... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's Asahina! Hi!
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh...
Otori.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Eep...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Yikes! She's doing that thing again!
She's smiling but not smiling!)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
N-N-N-N-No!
Nothing's wrong!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: L-Let's do our best again today!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Let's go in, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Asahina hasn't seemed like she's feeling all that great lately...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I've been seeing her more since becoming a class rep, and she always seems kinda down...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Otori?
The meeting's about to start.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
R-Right!
Coming!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Oh no... Thinking about too many things all at once is overloading my brain!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (We're about to have the class rep meeting, so I gotta focus all my attention on that!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Alright, I need to do my best so that everyone has a fun, exciting and wonderhoy time!)
se_run_women_002_1
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Vacant Classroom

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: Alright, let's begin the meeting.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: Today, we'll be discussing the volunteer work we do each year.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Volunteer work...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. This is going to be your first time, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Each year, the class representatives assist with local volunteer programs.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Last year, we picked up trash around the city, raised money for charity and helped out at the children's center.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?!
That sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. It actually is very rewarding.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: In particular, because the class representatives are essentially in charge of operations. We'll be recruiting other volunteers and coming up with detailed plans for how each program is run.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?!
We're in charge of operations?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's right. Some teachers will also be there, but in general, we have to take the lead.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you interested in running something like this, Otori?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes! I wanna learn all I can about running these kinds of events in order to make my dream come true!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see. Then, this should be a good opportunity for you.

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: Alright, as always, we'll be drawing program names from a box to see who is going to be in charge of what.

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: Each volunteer program will have two students assigned to it. After we draw names, you'll all break off into your pairs to discuss the details of your activities.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hehe. I can't wait to see where I get to volunteer.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Making the city sparkling clean by picking up trash would put smiles on the faces of everyone who comes to visit...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Raising money for charity would also help make lots and lots of people smile!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (And playing with kids at the children center would be so wonderhoy! No matter what I'm asked to do, I'm gonna do my absolute best!)

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: Next, Otori. Please draw a name for us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay! Hmm...
This one!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Let's see... Oh!
I'll be pulling weeds!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that means you're with me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?!
You got the same one, Asahina?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
Let's pull lots and lots of weeds together!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I have a feeling that doing this activity with you is going to be very fun.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, let's do our best.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (No, she's smiling but not again...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Wait, actually...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Us working together means I have a chance to make her really smile!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Which means I'll need to pull lots and lots of weeds and make Operation: Smiley Face a success!)

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: Alright, please break off into your pairs to discuss your various activities.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, why don't we take a look at what we'll actually be doing first?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: According to this printout, we'll be pulling weeds in the area highlighted on this map.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That includes this shrine's grounds and the surrounding neighborhood.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Also, the neighborhood association has already set the date, but the time of day seems to be up to us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Which means we'll need to come up with a schedule and figure out how many volunteers we'll need. There's also...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Asahina's really organized...!
She's so cool!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Alright, I've gotta do my best too!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, we also need to figure out what the volunteers should bring on the day of, as well as what equipment we'll need!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, we do.
People volunteer for this every year, from what I understand, so we should probably look at last year's records.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, this list should include all the equipment we need.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We also decided when and where to meet!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, that leaves...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Figuring out how we're actually going to recruit volunteers...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? How we're going to recruit them?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. Since we're being asked to cover quite a large area, I think we're going to need around thirty people...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But students at our school are usually busy with their clubs or studying for exams this time of year. Not to mention that people are unlikely to want to pull weeds in the summer heat. We'll obviously take measures to prevent anyone from getting heatstroke, but even still...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh... Right...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, we gotta recruit them in a way that'll get them to want to pull weeds with us!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Get them to want to pull weeds with us?
That isn't going to be easy...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We can start by putting up posters and handing out flyers... But we'll probably need to come up with more effective ideas...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmmmmmm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh!
What if we put on a show?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If we do a show about how fun it is to pull weeds, then others might decide to sign up!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
A show...
Yes, that is one way to advertise this event...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But we'd need to write the script, recruit a cast, secure equipment, make props and find a place to perform. I'm not sure we have the time to do all that...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, I know!
What if the two of us held a parade?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A parade?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes! I could bang a big drum really loudly while you play a recorder!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And we'd shout, “Pulling weeds with everyone is so much fun!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, wait...! Making a bunch of noise in a quiet neighborhood is probably a really bad idea...! Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's try brainstorming a little longer.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm...!
Then, what if we...?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh...
It's already time to go home.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?!
No, we still haven't come up with a good idea yet!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But you did come up with quite a lot, Otori. I really appreciate your creativity. I tried, but I couldn't think of anything promising either...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But we still have plenty of time, so let's do our best to keep coming up with ideas.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We can begin by making posters and flyers like we initially discussed.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I can make those!
I really love to draw!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And if those don't work, we'll try another method.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Roger dodger!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Alright...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I've gotta make a poster that's gonna make everyone want to pull weeds with us!)
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Humhumhumm♪
I'm the first one here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Lemme get my sketchbook and pens out and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Get started on Operation: Exciting Weed Pulling Poster☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My poster's gonna make pulling weeds look like so much fun that everyone's going to come join us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll have it say, “Fun volunteer opportunity! Come pull weeds with us!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Where should I write the date...?
Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
The posters for our shows always put that towards the bottom!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, I'll put the date somewhere around there, and have a picture of people pulling weeds in the middle!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Humhumhummｍ♪
Pulling weeds with everyone is so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Emu, you are here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Morning, Honami☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Good morning.
I just happened to hear your voice while working on some things for the cleanup committee.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? What are you drawing?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, this?!
Check it out! Ta-daa!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “Fun volunteer opportunity! Come pull weeds with us!”...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
I've been asked to volunteer to pull weeds as a class rep!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I was just working on a poster that's going to get more people to join us!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see.
These people pulling weeds have such lovely smiles on their faces.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This should help convince others that pulling weeds can be very fun.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You think so? Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
I bet this poster would become even more wonderhoy if you drew something, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I really love the way you draw because they're such a great expression of your feelings! They always look sparkly and fluffy and fuzzy and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I always love looking at them because they're so explosively eye-opening, like kapow!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I-I'm not sure if that counts as praise...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you, Emu...
Then, why don't I draw a little picture in this corner?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: How does this look...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that's really cute!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is that a butterfly?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, it's supposed to be a flower.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I thought that more flowers will be able to bloom once all the weeds have been pulled.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, now I see!
These little stick thingies must be the stamens, and the white flappy parts are the petals!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I apologize if it was hard to tell.
Anyway, I should get going...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, wait!
Can you draw more flowers for me?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I feel like that'll make this poster cuter and more fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, I'll draw a few more.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hehe. Thanks to Honami, this poster's gonna look super wonderhoy!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I can't wait to show it to Asahina!)
A few days later
Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If you don't mind, I'll use these chopsticks.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Umm... I've served everyone a bowl of rice, so I think we're ready to eat.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu, Honami & Kanade
rows.Line: Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for having me over again today. And for allowing me to join you for dinner.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My grandmother sent over a big box of vegetables, but they won't stay fresh for long. So, I'm glad you're here to help us get through them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm also glad.
But please feel free to have as much as you like, you two. These braised eggplants turned out even better than they did last time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You've looked really tired lately, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It has been very hot this summer.
If you like, I can make something that's easier on the stomach.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I was just thinking about something.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is something on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I've been asked to run a volunteer weeding program as part of my class representative duties, but we've been having trouble recruiting people...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Weeding...?
Will you be doing that with Emu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, how did you know...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I just happened to come across Emu drawing a poster for it the other day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ah, I see.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Recruiting people for that sounds really hard...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It is.
Especially since it's been so hot this year. No one seems interested.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Which is why I was thinking about other ways to get the word out.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I was just working on a poster that's going to get more people to join us!
The next day
Vacant Classroom

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hmm... I just checked the sign-up sheet, but it seems there haven't been any new volunteers.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... What can we do to make it so people want to come join us...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Well...
Our remaining options are...
Pardon me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu, Asahina, do you two have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? Honami? Is something the matter?
Are you here to do cleanup committee stuff?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No.
So...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If you're both okay with it, I'd like to volunteer to help pull weeds.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
R-Really?!
You'll come pull weeds with us?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes.
Also...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would it be alright if I helped a little with running this event? I feel like I want to lend you two a hand after seeing you putting in so much effort.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: H-Honami!!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mochizuki.
Then, I think we'll gladly accept your kind offer.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do our best together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I take it no one else has signed up to help?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
As far as volunteer work goes, it appears that this seems the most taxing in everyone's minds.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right.
It does involve manual labor...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... But I still think working together to make everything look pretty is gonna be a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Fun...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh...
What if we tried a new angle?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A new angle...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. For example, if all participants are promised a delicious meal, then they'll know that their hard work will be rewarded in the end.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that's really good!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, but you'll have budget constraints to think about, so I'm sure we can't do anything lavish like that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, I agree.
That is a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We should be upfront about how tough this is going to be, but also show that it can be very fun and rewarding. That should help convince people.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tough, but also fun...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(But how do we make this fun?
What would convince people to come pull weeds with us...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (How do we get the attention of all the school students, elderly residents and small children...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I know!
Asahina! Honami!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We should take this opportunity to go there for ourselves and investigate!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu & Honami
rows.Line: Investigate...?
After school

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Here we are! The place where we'll be pulling weeds!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, we're going to be in charge of the area spanning from here to the grounds of that shrine over there?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, so let's start looking around.
This may very well be the key to us finding the solution to our problems like you said, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Keisuke and Shosuke are always saying how important it is to go see things for yourself when planning a new ride or event...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (So, we have to observe things really closely, and try to come up with a way to make pulling weeds really fun!)
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh!
There's a park over there!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
It's so cute and little.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And it has plenty of shade, so it must be cool. We could use it as a rest area.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rest...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
What if we all had lunch there?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's a nice idea.
We could have ourselves a big picnic.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, we could. Our original plan was to have everyone go wherever they like, but having lunch as a group could be very fun.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But, that likely won't be enough to convince people to join us. Let's keep walking around to see if we can find something else.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I see the shrine!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, there it is.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-This shrine has a very...rustic feel to it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes...
It looks quite old...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! Look at all the crows perched up there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Caw! Caw!
Hello-caw!
se_event_horror_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe♪ They greeted me back!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-They sound a little angry to me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Anyway, shall we keep going...?
We may find something new.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's keep exploring!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Okay...
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh...
It's so dark here. I'm starting to get a little scared...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Me too.
But it doesn't feel that hot here because of all the shade these trees provide.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. Pulling weeds here might not actually be so bad...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
More people might come if we let them know that it's not gonna be as hot as they think!

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line: Ah, are you here to visit the shrine?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Eep!
Y-You scared us...

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line:
Oh, I didn't mean to startle you.
It's just so rare to see anybody here at this time of day during the week.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Excuse me, but you are...?

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line:
Ah, where are my manners?
My name is Kawada. I'm this shrine's head priest.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
It's nice to meet you. We're all students at Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're volunteering to pull out all the weeds, so we came to see what things are like around here!

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line:
Ah, you're the Miya Girls students!
Yes, I've heard about you.

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line:
Thank you very much for volunteering.
I'm sure you ladies have better things to do than pull weeds at this old shrine...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: N-No, it's our pleasure! I was a little surprised at first... But it's actually a very charming place, with so much greenery.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm also glad we came. You can really feel this place's history.

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
That's very kind of you to say.

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: The truth is, I'm also looking forward to you all coming to volunteer.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: I do my best to keep this shrine in good shape, but it doesn't get many visitors since it tends to make people feel a little uncomfortable.

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: Which is why I'm hoping that everyone who comes to volunteer will have a chance to become more familiar with this place.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (If that's the case, then I wanna recruit as many volunteers as I can for him!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Still, how do we do that...?
It's nice and cool with plenty of greenery here, but I'm not sure how fun that makes this place...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Excuse me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Are there any spots in this area that you would recommend to visit?! Preferably something that everybody would enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: Something that everybody would enjoy...?

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but there isn't really anything besides this shrine and the mountain behind it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mountain?

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: Yes. Actually, it's more of a large hill than a mountain. Our shrine has been watching over it for generations, and it has a similar atmosphere to the shrine itself...

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: So I wouldn't call it fun so much as scary...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Scary...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is that it over there?

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line:
Yes.
You can reach it by taking the path out back.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Oh, all the big trees make everything look dark and spooky...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hmm... But I'm kinda interested since it looks like just the sort of place where you'd see ghosts...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm...? Ghosts...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: AHHHHHH!!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
Wh-What's wrong, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Excuse me!
If we aren't allowed to, that's okay...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But can we try doing a test of courage there?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu & Honami
rows.Line: What...?
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Vacant Classroom

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Asahinaaa!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is it true that more people have signed up to pull weeds with us?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I was also surprised when the teacher told me the news. It seems that ten people have signed up just today.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whaaat?! Ten people?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. They apparently all decided to sign up after seeing the posters and flyers you made, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You did a particularly good job with that poster. The way you had “Pulling Weeds!” and “Test of Courage!” written next to each other made it very easy to understand what this event involves.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It sparked interest among my classmates. They were all chatting about what it could mean to pull weeds while doing a test of courage.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's all thanks to your hard work, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe!
We also have you to thank you for helping!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe.
We should be able to get more than enough people to sign up now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Still, I really wasn't expecting to hold a test of courage after the weed-pulling...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: When I heard how spooky people thought the shrine and mountain were, our park's haunted house came to mind.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because it's scary, but it can also be fun!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, some people don't like being scared, but others really enjoy those kinds of things.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Still, as surprised as I was, it's very like you to find the fun in fear.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Let's do our best together and make our test of courage a really fun one!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, umm... About that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm one of those who don't really enjoy being scared, so I'm not sure how I'll be able to help...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Don't worry!
We're gonna make it a happy smiley test of courage that even those who don't really like horror and stuff can enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A happy smiley test of courage...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't say that I have a clear picture of what we're going to do yet, but I'm sure it'll be fun with you in charge, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks! It will be!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, let's start coming up with ideas for our test of courage!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Alright, regarding the program of events for our test of courage, does sticking with what we discussed previously sound good?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes! We'll all meet up at the shrine after pulling weeds and take groups off up the mountain one at a time!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, how big should each group be...?
Normally, you do these in pairs...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... It isn't always easy for a random pair to strike up a conversation, so how about three per group?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That sounds good.
They'll be walking along a mountain path in the dark, so more people may be better in this case.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, three per group...
We also need to decide how often we send groups out...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But that will depend on the distance between the shrine and the end of the trail, as well as how we decide to frighten them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Right. Why don't we leave measuring out the length of the trail for a later date, and today we can focus on how we're going to scare them?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I have an idea!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wanna dress up like a monster plushie that jumps out at everyone, but isn't too scary!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
A monster plushie?
Yes, that wouldn't be all that frightening.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: In that case, let's come up with some designs for your monster costume today. Then, on the weekend...
Holiday
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Humhumhummｍ♪
Monster, monster, monster costume shopping♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We came up with quite a few costume designs during our brainstorming session.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
We did.
Unfortunately, I don't think we'll be able to make all of them with just three of us, so we'll need to narrow them down.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But for now, we should head over to the handicrafts shop in the mall and—
Huh? Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, I thought it was you!
And you've got Honami and Emu with you!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Mizuki? Hinomori?
What are you two doing here?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh. Shizuku and I just spent some time hanging out together at the sewing lounge!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Were you three about to head somewhere?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yes!
We're gonna go buy stuff for our test of courage!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Test of courage?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're recruiting volunteers to pull weeds with us, but had to come up with a way to make things more fun for everyone...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
Which is why you're having a test of courage.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! We were just about to go buy stuff to make a cute monster costume!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? A cute monster?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We'll be working with some of the locals in the area, so we decided to make as cute a monster as possible to ensure that people who don't like being scared can also have fun.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Cool...!
That does sound like fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, can I join in?
I can probably give you three a hand with your costume since I'm pretty good at making those kinds of things!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I can make one that's all pink and frilly!
Or a monster with cat ears! The possibilities are endless!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What...?!
You'd help us?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! Also, I can probably pull weeds and do your test of courage as long as I find someone to cover for me at work.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, wait a second...
Is it okay for a student from another school to participate?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That should be fine since we're already recruiting local residents. Still, are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course!
After going to the sewing lounge, I really feel like making some more stuff! Plus, this sounds like a really fun opportunity♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree.
In that case, I'd like to help out as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let me check to see if I'm free that day to pull weeds.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Wait, Hinomori, you too...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But aren't you busy with work...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We're in a bit of a lull period at the moment, so I should be able to at least help with your monster costume.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
I really appreciate you offering to help like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It's okay.
Also, Asahina may already know this...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I happen to have something that you may be able to use during your test of courage♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Something we can use during our test of courage...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, are you talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
It does seem perfect for this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, don't leave us in the dark!
What are you two talking about?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll bring it over when we make our monster costumes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: C'mon, do you have to leave me hanging like that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway, Shizuku and I wanna help.
What do you say? Would that be okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes, thank you both very much!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Hehe. I'm looking forward to working with you all on this!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So, let's go grab what we need!
I know a great handicrafts shop that sells cute fabrics and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay!
Then, let's go go go!
Volunteer Day
Shrine

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Please come over here and form an orderly line for me, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe...!
It's great how so many little kids decided to join us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, it is...
Things feel so lively with so many people from the community gathered together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Quite a few seem to be here for the test of courage since it's not often that they get to do one.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Alright!
Let's do our best to make sure they enjoy pulling weeds and our test of courage!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... Has Mizuki not arrived yet...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I just received a message. “I'll get there when the test of courage starts.”

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Apparently, no one was available to cover at work, so we won't be seeing Mizuki until later this evening.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: To add, “I'm really sorry, but I promise to make up for it during the test of courage!”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
Then, the four of us will need to pull as many weeds as we can!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's make Operation: Exciting Weed Pulling a big success!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't realize you'd come up with such a wonderful name.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm guessing she just came up with that, but it is definitely Otori's kind of name.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's do this!
Here we...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu, Honami & Shizuku
rows.Line: Go!

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler A
rows.Line:
Out you...!
Hnng! It's totally stuck!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is everything okay? Would you like some help?

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler A
rows.Line: Oh, so... These weeds are so stubborn!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, these?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You should be able to pull them out if you carve a little circle around them with your trowel first.

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler A
rows.Line:
A circle...?
Hey, look at that! They came right out!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You did a wonderful job! Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, to celebrate... Let's high five♪

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler A
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks for helping me, you two!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Everyone, please place the weeds you've pulled into your plastic bags and bring them to the collection area over here once they're full.

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Students
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line:
Phew...
We're in the shade, but it's still pretty hot...

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I'm drenched in sweat!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh...!
I believe it's time for your hard work to be rewarded!

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line: Huh? Rewarded?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Here's some nice and cool shaved ice that Asahina and I just made!

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
Yay! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There's enough for everyone, so please come and get them one at a time.

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Students
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Operation: Shaved Ice seems to be going very well, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, but the line's getting huge...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We gotta keep making more!
Spin! Spin! Spin! Spin!
se_event_horror_2024_002

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Maybe getting one with a manually operated crank to cut costs wasn't such a good idea...
Park

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Mmm!
It's so much fun to eat as a big group like this!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I agree.
And having worked so hard to pull those weeds makes this lunch taste even better.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. We should be able to recharge our batteries for this afternoon.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Not only that, everyone is...)

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line:
You're all students, right?
Thank you for working so hard to pull weeds with us.

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line:
No, it's our pleasure!
Pulling weeds with all of you has been really fun!

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler B
rows.Line: Hey, is the stuff you study in high school really hard?

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line:
Yeah, super duper hard.
What sort of stuff are you studying recently?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They all seem to be having a fun time interacting with the locals...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm glad we decided to all have lunch here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'm so glad that they're all having fun!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Alright, I've gotta keep doing my best until the very end!)

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line: Keep it up! Just a little bit more to go!

rows.Speaker: Participants
rows.Line: Okay!!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (We should be finished pulling these weeds in about thirty minutes. I'm glad things are moving right on schedule.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But we need to stay focused throughout the test of courage. We need to make sure nothing goes wrong there...)
Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh...?
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello.
I know you must be tired, so please take this sports drink if you like.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You've been working very hard, so please make sure to take breaks when you can, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, umm... Thank you, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: How are you feeling...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This might be none of my business, but... I've been worrying that you might be pushing yourself too hard.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm okay...
I don't feel all that tired since we have so many people here helping us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Really?
That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But please let me know if anything happens or if you start feeling fatigued.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll be right there to help.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you.
A few hours later
Mountain

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's see... Just gotta mark where to jump out and... All set!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm done over here♪
How are you guys doing, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We've finished setting up as well.
So, that just leaves...
se_run_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hi, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff... Sorry for the wait!
This customer asked me to help with their outfit near the end of my shift, and I really had my work cut out for me!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's okay.
We haven't begun the test of courage yet.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Exactly!
So, let's have go out there and have fun scaring everyone!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I promise to be a really good scarer in return for being late!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, now that we're all here, let's quickly review the plan.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Starting with our roles.
I'll be guiding everyone to the finish line, while the rest of you will be scarers.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Each group will consist of three people.
Whenever I reach a scare point, I'll give the signal for you to jump out—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And that's when we jump out and scare the pants off them!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki, Honami & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That's it for me...
Is there anything you'd like to add, Otori?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Anything I'd like to add...?
Oh, that reminds me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't want just the participants of our test of courage to have fun. I want everyone to, including the guide and the scarers!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's all enjoy ourselves and make sure we all go home smiling!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki, Honami, Mafuyu & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's very dark, so please watch your step as you go along.

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line: I-It's a lot darker than I thought...!

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student C
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
And that tree... I bet something's gonna jump out at us from behind it!

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line: Still, it's really nice to have Asahina guiding us through...!

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Even if a ghost were to pop out, we should be fine!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Are you sure about that?
What if I dashed ahead and left you all behind?

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line: No, please don't!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Oh, wait. Did you hear that?

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student C
rows.Line:
Huh? Hear what...?
Don't tell me...
“Grrr...”
“Rawr! Raaawr!”

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line:
Eep! Wait, huh...?
Hold on...

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line: That was actually kinda cute...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Now, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line: Huh? Something's coming at us from behind...
“Woof! Woof! Woof!”

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line:
Huh?!
I-It's a big monster... No, wait!

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line:
Check it out! It's a big dog plushie!
It's so adorable!
se_walk_women_003_1
se_walk_women_003_2

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line: This isn't scary at all. I guess we got all worked up over nothing.

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line: If anything, this is sorta heartwarming.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. But this dog isn't alone.
Quite a few other ghosts haunt this place, so you'll have to keep your eyes peeled.

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line:
...!
Hey, I'm hearing more weird noises.

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student C
rows.Line: M-Me too... And it sounds like they're getting closer.
Meooow!

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Students
rows.Line: *Scream*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Meow♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Meow♪　Meow meow♪

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line:
Huh...? Wh-What?
It's hopping around so much.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Looks like you're here to test your courage meow♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There are lots of fun and scary things up ahead meow! But it's really dark, so be careful meow♪

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line: Oh! It's so cute and helpful!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. Looks like you're welcome here.
Thank you, Ms. Monster.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we keep going?

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line:
Okay!
Bye bye, Ms. Monster!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Bye bye meow!

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line:
That monster was so nice...!
I kinda wish we could've stayed to talk to her more!

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line:
Me too! Huh...?
Is it just me, or is it starting to get colder?

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It was really warm a second ago. Wait, does this mean...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes.
Legend has it that she appears here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ah, take a look.
se_event_horror_2024_003
se_walk_women_003_1
se_walk_women_003_1
Good evening.

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line: I-It's...

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line:
Shizuku Hinomori!
*Scream*

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line: Th-This is my first time seeing her up close! I only saw her from afar a couple of times while pulling weeds...

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student C
rows.Line:
A-And she's dressed as a yuki-onna!
How often does this happen?!

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line: Also, why's it snowing here?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As a yuki-onna, I have the power to make it snow♪ Isn't it perfect for a hot summer day?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You're welcome to rest and cool down here.
But please watch your step when you resume your adventure.

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line: Thank you!
se_walk_women_003_1
se_walk_women_003_2

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Talk about elegance!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You did such a wonderful job that you seemed just like the real thing...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad that I was able to borrow that snow maker from Kamishiro♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: On top of being really cute, you gave them a chance to cool down while they tested their courage!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Anyway, let's keep up the good work, and scare lots and lots more people!

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schoolers
rows.Line: That was a really fun test of courage!

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schoolers
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It's wasn't scary at all! Let's go again!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mr. Head Priest! We're back!!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: All the participants have safely descended the mountain and gone home. Oh, one group is still using the restroom. Once we see them off, that'll be everyone.

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line:
Ah, welcome back.
Thank you for being such wonderful monsters and spirits.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Pardon me!

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, he was a part of the final group...
Is something the matter...?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
I... I had a lot of fun today!
I promise to come back again soon!

rows.Speaker: Boy's Father
rows.Line:
Kenta!
If you're done using the bathroom, we're going home!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Okay!
Anyway, thanks again for today!

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line:
He wants to come back.
I don't know what to say...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: Yes, it is...

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: Even while we pulled weeds, I heard quite a few people say many kind things.

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line:
And I have all of you to thank.
Your efforts have not gone unnoticed.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I'm so glad we got everyone to smile!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway!
Now that everyone's gone, let's start cleaning up!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right.
It's very dark, so we'll need to be careful.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It feels much spookier now...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, sir... Would you mind lending us the key to the storeroom? We'd like to put back everything we borrowed.

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Let me just... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
I can't seem to find the key to the storeroom...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: I might've dropped it somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Would you like us to help you look?
If you can tell us about where you think you dropped it...

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line:
Yes, so...
I definitely had it on me after we finished pulling weeds. I remember going to and from the storeroom a few times.

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: Then, I walked the course for your test of courage to make sure everything was ready. Which means...

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: I may have dropped it somewhere along that path.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Along the course...?
That may make finding it a bit difficult.

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line:
I know...
But you've all been working since morning. I couldn't possibly ask you to...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, I wanna help!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We might find it while we're cleaning everything up, so I'll be more than happy to look for it...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Me too...!
I've still got plenty of stamina left!

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, I think we've reached a consensus.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The course itself is very long, so let's divide it up into two halves. Sir, if you, Hinomori and Mizuki can search the area from the start line until the midpoint...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Otori, Mochizuki and I will search the latter half.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, sounds good!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: U-Until the finish line...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. It's part two of our test of courage! Let's do our best, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
Mountain
se_walk_women_003_1
se_walk_women_003_2

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm... Mr. Key, Mr. Key...
Come out, come out wherever you are!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's gotten so dark. Finding it won't be easy...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
N-No, it won't...
Also, we need to be careful not to trip and fall...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Eep!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
H-Honami?!
What's wrong?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: S-S-S-Something cold just grazed my face...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I think it's just a leaf...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Take a look at this branch.
It hangs down to about your face, Mochizuki, and it's waving in the breeze.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
This is so embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We can hold hands if you're feeling scared, Honami! Here, nice and tight!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-Thank you so much, Emu...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe...
You two are so close.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Still, this day's ending with quite the predicament...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, it is...
I hope we find that key soon...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I kinda like this since we basically get to do another test of courage!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You seem to be smiling for real now, Asahina! That makes me really happy!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh? For real...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
N-No, wait...! I meant...! Uhhhhhh...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The thing is...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I notice sometimes how you'll smile, but it doesn't seem like a real smile.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And especially recently, you've seemed sad despite having a smile on your face. Which started to worry me...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But...!
I feel a lot better because you seem to be smiling for real now...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That makes me really happy!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why does me having a real smile make you happy, Otori?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Why...? Umm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because I can't help but feel excited when I see you smiling for real, and that makes me smile too!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
...
I'm not sure I follow your reasoning...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think I understand how Emu feels.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's hard not to feel happy when you see someone you care about smile.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That reminds me of...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want you to feel what I did. I want you to smile the way I did back then.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Kanade said the same thing.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Then...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Otori and Mochizuki care about how I feel, just like Kanade?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
...!
Asahina, you just...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Scream*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wh-Wh-Wh-What's wrong?!
Is everything okay, Honami?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Th-Th-Th-The grass just rustled...!
And something ran by...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, what if it was a ghost?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Where'd it go?!
Do you think it's gone now?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I think it's still there...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What...?
Wh-Where?! Don't tell me...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes.
Look there...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's a tanuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Tanuki
rows.Line: Squeal.
se_event_horror_2024_004

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
...!
It is a tanuki...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! It's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Do you think it lives on this mountain? Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There's something caught on its tail!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really? I'm having trouble seeing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, look!
There's a string or something wrapped around its tail.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
...!
I think that's the key to the storeroom.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When I first borrowed it, I remember seeing a lanyard attached to it. A red one just like that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, we need to get it back!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Stay really still for us, Mr. Tanuki...

rows.Speaker: Tanuki
rows.Line: Squeal?
se_event_horror_2024_005

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We're your friends...
See? Pom-poko-pom-poko...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, got it!

rows.Speaker: Tanuki
rows.Line: Squeal!
se_event_horror_2024_006

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. It looks so happy now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But how'd this get wrapped around its tail?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hmm...
It may've gotten caught on its tail after the head priest dropped the key.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Still, I'm glad we found it.
We probably never would have if that tanuki decided to disappear into the woods.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
True...
Hehe. That makes us very lucky.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Now let's tell Mizuki and the others the good news, then head back to the shrine!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Heave-ho, heave-ho...
That's the chairs returned to the storeroom...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Phew...
Is that everything we needed to put back?

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line:
Yes, I just need to lock the doors now...
Thank you all very much for your help.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, thank you for having us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Anyway, it's gotten very late.
Shall we start heading out, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Aww, this is really it for our test of courage...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It flew by so fast.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, saying goodbye to this place isn't going to be easy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I forgot to say something really important!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Emu!
Thanks for today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You came up with this idea, right?
I had so much fun making costumes and scaring everybody.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. I know I was playing a monster, but seeing everyone smile filled me with so much joy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was frightened at the thought of a test of courage, but your idea made it fun for all of us, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's because you put so much thought and effort into it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. But this was only possible because all of you decided to help! So, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I need to thank you for today as well.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (She's really smiling...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Of course!
Thank you as well!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I promise to keep doing my best as a class rep! And I look forward to working with you in the future...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Me too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...!
Asahina's got such a big smile on her face!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Seeing others smile like this really makes me so happy!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem so happy, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I am!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, today ended up being such a wonderhoy day!
